definitions: A piece of thick stiff paper or thin plastic with a picture and often a message, used for sending greetings or invitations.
A small rectangular piece of plastic, issued by a bank or other financial institution, allowing the holder to withdraw money or to pay for goods and services.
One of a set of 52 playing cards.
A small rectangular piece of paper or plastic containing data about a person or item, used for identification or information.
examples: She sent me a birthday card.
I paid with my credit card.
He drew the ace of spades from the deck of cards.
He's a bit of a card, always telling jokes.
